page.overview:
What is Afton Robotics, LLC?

, fully known as Afton Robotics, Limited Liability Company, is a robotics company founded by William Afton, one of the co-founders of Fazbear Entertainment, Inc..

The first establishment of the company is Circus Baby's Pizza World, which supposedly had much excitement being built up around the location opening. Before doing so however, [https://freddy-fazbears-pizza.fandom.com/wiki/Minor_Characters_(FNaF:_SL)#Circus_Baby's_Minigame_Children a few kids from here and there] are let in to make sure everything works right. Portrayed in Circus Baby's minigame, Elizabeth Afton is among the handful to see inside of the building and is murdered by Circus Baby while there. According to a local, they just stop talking about it when the grand opening is reportedly cancelled due to gas leaks, as a coverup for Elizabeth's demise. As described in a newspaper article on the situation, sources near to the establishment question the reported gas leaks and wonder if something more is to blame, hinted at by strange activity in the area at night. A tenant from across the street witnesses a large group of car riders surround the building in the night and remove pieces of their large equipment under tarps. The building of Circus Baby's Pizza World is put up for sale after a few weeks, while William refrains from commenting on the situation.

Afton Robotics, LLC's second business venture is an animatronic rental business, Circus Baby's Entertainment and Rental, operated through an underground animatronic maintenance facility. The company appears to be a part of Fazbear Entertainment, Inc., or at least eventually sold to become apart of it, since later games present their animatronics alongside aside Fazbear Entertainment, Inc.'s own characters with little to no distinction between them. They would also most likely require permission from Fazbear Entertainment, Inc. to manufacture new versions of their characters as well. The Survival Logbooks even considers "Afton Robotics" to be a "Fazbear Entertainment-related word".

Afton Robotics, LLC appears on the blueprints of Circus Baby, Ballora, Funtime Freddy, Funtime Foxy, and Circus Baby's Entertainment and Rental. Similarly to Mike Schmidt's paychecks, the copyright dates for the animatronic blueprints are simply left as "XXXX", likely to just keep the year ambiguous. Circus Baby's Entertainment and Rental assumedly closes after the events of Night 5, due to the deaths of several employees, a lack of animatronic entertainers because of Ennard, and the fact that the establishment goes largely unreferenced in future material.
